message.content:
Below is a list of the **federal holidays** in Canada that create *long weekends* in 2023.  
(If you’re planning for a specific province, let me know—some holidays differ by region.)

| Holiday | Date in 2023 | Weekend Impact |
|---------|--------------|----------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (Sunday) – observed Mon 2 | Long weekend: Dec 30–Jan 2 |
| **Family Day** *(Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario)* | Feb 20 (Monday) | Long weekend: Feb 18–20 |
| **Good Friday** *(most provinces, not Quebec)* | Apr 7 (Friday) | Long weekend: Apr 7–9 |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | Long weekend: May 20–22 |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Saturday) – observed Mon 3 | Long weekend: Jul 1–3 |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | Long weekend: Sep 2–4 |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | Long weekend: Oct 7–9 |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Monday) | Long weekend: Dec 23–25 |

> **Notes**  
> • **Remembrance Day** (Nov 11) is a statutory holiday in several provinces but does not usually create a long weekend unless observed on a Monday.  
> • Provincial holidays such as **St. Patrick’s Day** (NL), **St. George’s Day** (PEI), **Civic Holiday** (BC, NB, PEI, NL, Manitoba), and others may also generate long weekends depending on the province.  

Let me know if you’d like the list tailored to a particular province or if you need additional details!
